bound_decisions.accepted_swaps_note: accepted_swaps is reported per rewire row for the record, but the pinned TopologyOverlay.degree_preserving_random refuses any shortfall, so it structurally equals requested_swaps=887; the freeze review probed all 199 condition seeds building successfully
bound_decisions.analysis: per task and null condition: per-instance mean test MSE across the 10 shared drive seeds; empirical p = (1 + #nulls <= connectome mean)/(N+1) with N=199, lower MSE better; Holm-Bonferroni across the 6 comparisons at alpha 0.05
bound_decisions.biological_readout_regime: dropped from v1 with reason: the 2-pool wing-motor regime requires binding the flight-controller pool projection into the offline harness; deferred to an openly recorded amendment so v1's scope stays the full-hidden-state readout
bound_decisions.blas_warning_note: macOS/Accelerate emits spurious floating-point-flag RuntimeWarnings in the ridge matmul; the freeze review probed the gram matrices as exactly finite, and the fail-closed non-finite guards remain the real protection. Accepted as noise
bound_decisions.drive: continuous SHA-256-derived unit streams on bodies 77185/805722, amplitude 0.5
bound_decisions.dropped_task: FOM-trace distillation (trace-binding complexity; amendable in a later version)
bound_decisions.intercept: one constant 1.0 column appended to the hidden state
bound_decisions.l2_selection: per run on the validation slice; test MSE reported once
bound_decisions.power_rationale: N=199 puts the minimum achievable empirical p at 1/200 = 0.005, strictly below the first Holm-Bonferroni threshold 0.05/6 ~= 0.00833 across the 6 confirmatory comparisons. The freeze review demonstrated that the draft's N=100 (min p 1/101 ~= 0.0099) could never reject any hypothesis under that correction; this is the recorded fix, made before any result existed.
bound_decisions.readout_weight_hashing: solver output is never hashed into any identity; metrics are reported floats, same-build scoped
bound_decisions.recurrence_axis_note: the connectome-vs-sign_ablated_zero comparison is descriptive only: a deterministic condition has no null distribution, so it receives no inferential treatment
bound_decisions.rl_arm: out of scope for this freeze; requires its own protocol (E3)
bound_decisions.run_identity_hardening: engine and identity built atomically pre-step from one call (trm_e1.built_run); fresh-engine guard enforced; drives validated by construction before hashing
bound_decisions.seed_derivation: null seeds: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON of {protocol_id, role='null', condition, null_index} (trm_e1.condition_seed, first 16 hex chars as an integer); drive/input streams: SHA-256 counters over the pipe-joined prefix protocol_id|role|seed_index|channel (trm_tasks.unit_stream). The two derivation domains are disjoint by construction; binding is by the code hashes above
bound_decisions.signs_under_rewire: signs travel with edge slots (the harness's declared default)
bound_decisions.smoke_limit_guard: --limit refuses the canonical result path so a partial document can never occupy the immutable output
bound_decisions.strength_matched_null: dropped: not implementable without amending a pilot-pinned file
